question: Should the temple be proportioned by hand measure according to the previously stated method?
premises: Temple proportions follow stated fractional divisions.
Hand measure may also be used.
inference: The builder should apply the prior proportional method even when using hand measure.
uncertainties: Exact sandhi decomposition of the fused first token.
The precise companion intended by saha.
plain_english: Even when measuring by the hand, one should construct the temple according to the previously stated method, together with those proportions.
